projects.name: ufo
projects.description: Pure string/URL functions: the no-mocking baseline.

expectedRefinements.reason: parseURL(input, defaultProto): no ufo test passes a default protocol, so `defaultProto + input` is never evaluated; selection reports no-coverage where the full suite reports survived.

`$URL.isAbsolute` is `this.hasProtocol || this.pathname[0] === "/"`; every test that reads it (the `getters` test, and `href`, which asks `hasProtocol && isAbsolute`) has a protocol, so `||` short-circuits and `pathname[0] === "/"` is never evaluated. Selection reports no-coverage where the full suite reports survived.

`resolveURL` overrides the hash only when `urlSegment.hash && urlSegment.hash !== "#"`; no test passes a later segment that carries a hash (test/resolve.test.ts has a hash only in the first, base segment), so `hash !== "#"` is never evaluated.

expectedTimeouts.reason: `index` in the resolve loop (`index >= -1 && !resolvedAbsolute`) counts up instead of down, so with no absolute segment its condition never fails and the loop never ends.
`index` in the normalize loop (`index <= path.length`) counts down instead of up, so the condition always holds and the loop never ends.
`i` in the segment loop (`i >= 0`) counts up instead of down, so the condition always holds and the loop never ends.

expectedRefinements.reason: `reverseResolveAlias` evaluates `alias.slice(0, -1)` only for an alias target that ends in a slash; every target in test/utils.spec.ts (`/src`, `C:/src`, `/root`, `/root/some/assets`, ...) has none, so the `-1` is never evaluated.
